history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG - generic CSV name: several 'Shani Mandir' shrines exist in and around Hoshiarpur. The best-supported referent for this row is Shri Shani Dev Mandir at NH 344B, Sukhiabad, Bhawani Nagar, Hoshiarpur 146001 - documented by Justdial (5.0, 59 ratings; hours 06:00 AM-09:00 PM daily), yappe.in (~2.16 km from Hoshiarpur railway station) and akhandapp.in (4.7). Alternatives that must NOT be conflated: (a) a 'Shani Mandir' near Mehanta Da Dera, opp. CA Staff, Hoshiarpur (place pin 31.53949, 75.924301); (b) Shivalaya & Shani Mandir at Garhdiwala on SH24, dedicated to both Shiva and Shani (hours 08:30-22:00). No founding history is published for the Bhawani Nagar shrine; it is a modern local temple of Shani (Navagraha) worship, typically busiest on Saturdays. CSV town/district/state (Hoshiarpur, Punjab) are correct. No reliable temple-specific photograph was found after genuine searching, so media is empty.

name: Shani Dev Mandir
town_description: Hoshiarpur is a city and district headquarters in the Doaba region of north-east Punjab, on the edge of the Shivalik foothills. The temple stands at Bhawani Nagar/Sukhiabad on NH 344B, about 2.2 km from Hoshiarpur railway station.

travel.airport: Adampur (Jalandhar) Airport is the nearest domestic airport (verify distance, roughly 30-40 km); Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport, Amritsar is the nearest international airport (verify).
travel.railway: Hoshiarpur railway station is about 2.2 km away (per yappe.in).
travel.road: On NH 344B at Sukhiabad/Bhawani Nagar, Hoshiarpur 146001; reached by auto/taxi from the city centre.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant Punjab weather (verify). Saturdays are the traditional busy day for Shani worship.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 06:00 AM - 09:00 PM daily (per Justdial). Confirm locally before visiting.
